label: Bible Study
prompt: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh _____;
verse: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
note: Paul's chain reaction — tribulation, patience, experience, hope — and hope doesn't disappoint.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Giving _____ always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
verse: Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ;
note: Giving thanks always, for all things — Paul doesn't leave much room for exceptions.

label: Sunday School
prompt: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is _____:
verse: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:
note: The Gibeonites' trick: show off mouldy bread as 'proof' of a long journey — and Israel didn't ask God first.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a _____ in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
verse: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
note: Paul never names his thorn — he asked three times for it to go and got 'My grace is sufficient' instead.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be _____.
verse: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
note: Written in bonds (1:13): Paul says he 'learned' to be content — it didn't come naturally even to him.
